title: Independently review the selected target report and evidence
objective: Independently inspect every Q01-Q16 and B1-B10 raw evidence item for the selected target, verify job and report-subject binding, confirm the fallback rule, and run the installed Harness checker. Write a review bound to review_subject(report), with reviewer identity different from the author.
test_seam: Fresh-context adversarial review against the accepted sources and actual CI job, not only report shape. Any unauthenticated, absent or unverifiable raw evidence forces NOT QUALIFIED.
